patterns.name: large_unfamiliar_destination
patterns.condition: T1041 or T1048, severity >=10, destination exists, >=50 MB sent, and first-seen destination or clearly abnormal bulk data transfer
patterns.evidence: T1041 and T1048 describe exfiltration through command channels or alternate network protocols.

patterns.name: repeated_bulk_exfiltration
patterns.condition: T1041 or T1048, severity >=10, destination exists, >=50 MB and repeated transfers or many files
patterns.evidence: Repeated high-volume outbound transfers can indicate staged data exfiltration.

patterns.name: off_hours_archive_transfer
patterns.condition: T1048, severity >=10, destination exists, >=50 MB, compressed archive and unfamiliar destination or off-hours activity
patterns.evidence: T1048 includes exfiltration using an alternate protocol, and anomalous archive transfer is a supporting indicator.

patterns.name: weak_outbound_anomaly
patterns.condition: T1041 or T1048 and severity 5-9 with isolated, unverified or low-volume transfer anomalies
patterns.evidence: A single outbound transfer or small archive is insufficient to establish confirmed exfiltration.
